newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures fall, sentiment bearish.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures fall, sentiment bearish.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Tuesday, as sentiment was still dampened by the Asian currency crisis and concerns that the Thai government may sell its rubber stocks, traders said.
Nervousness ahead of the August spot contract expiry next Monday also weighed on sentiment, they said.
Prices ranged from 1.7 yen to 3.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark January was off 3.0 yen at 112.3 yen.
"There were no bullish factors. Prices are expected to drift lower this week," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
